snapshot.text: Fragmented system with five subsystems: the Ministry of Health (Minsa) covers about 60% of people, EsSalud about 30%, and the armed forces, police and private sector the rest. Poorer groups have less access to care. President Keiko Fujimori's government took office on 28 July 2026.

priorities.title: Strengthen primary care facilities
priorities.text: Minister Dyer said Minsa will prioritise first-level facilities (postas and health centres) to relieve congested hospitals. He also named improving the medical appointment system as a strategic axis.

priorities.title: Minsa reorganisation and management review
priorities.text: The government declared Minsa under reorganisation for 90 days, to assess its administrative, organisational and management situation and to propose reforms.

priorities.title: Joined PAHO primary care alliance
priorities.text: In May 2026 Peru formally joined the Alliance for Primary Health Care in the Americas, led by PAHO, the IDB and the World Bank. It aims to strengthen health systems through investment and technical cooperation.

netherlands.text: The Netherlands and Peru jointly led adoption of the 2024 World Health Assembly resolution on climate change and health. I found no bilateral health programme in my searches.
